_comment: Deployed to nas:/etc/nas-replica-raiser/job.json. batch_gb bounds one batch's logical size; peak_margin multiplies the transient raw peak (size x replica delta) that must fit in free space. current_level is only used by `pause` (what a still-pending file is reverted to). Order matters: entries are processed top to bottom. granularity 'dir' stamps immediate SUBDIRECTORIES instead of files (for trees too large to classify file by file) and is only allowed for erasure_code campaigns, since unit sizes are then unknown; such an entry batches by chunks_per_batch and may set require_ssd_foreground=false + max_ec_pending_gb, because turning EC on for data already at its replica target writes no extra copies.

entries._why: 1.4 TiB of immutable S3 objects, already 3x; one chunk, as a canary before the big bucket.
19.4 TiB in 924 dated dirs (~21 GiB each), the pool's biggest 3x tree; 4+2 EC frees ~32 TB.
finished Sep 9; kept so a re-download inherits the same policy.
